Here’s a list of well-known **office furniture brand websites** categorized by region and type (premium, mid-range, budget, and specialty):

---

### **🌍 Global & Premium Brands (High-End & Design-Focused)**
1. **Herman Miller** – [www.hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com)
   - Iconic ergonomic chairs (Aeron, Embody), modern office systems.
2. **Steelcase** – [www.steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com)
   - Workplace solutions, ergonomic seating, and collaborative furniture.
3. **Knoll** – [www.knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com)
   - Mid-century modern designs, office systems, and designer collaborations.
4. **Haworth** – [www.haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com)
   - Ergonomic chairs (Zody, Fern), modular workstations.
5. **Vitra** – [www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com)
   - High-end designer furniture (Eames, Panton, Alcove Sofa).
6. **Okamura** – [www.okamura.com](https://www.okamura.com) (Japan)
   - Premium ergonomic chairs (Contessa, ProFlex).
7. **Humanscale** – [www.humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com)
   - Minimalist, ergonomic chairs (Freedom, Diffrient Smart).
8. **Teknion** – [www.teknion.com](https://www.teknion.com)
   - Modular office systems, acoustic solutions.
9. **KI (Krueger International)** – [www.ki.com](https://www.ki.com)
   - Flexible workplace furniture, education, and healthcare solutions.
10. **Fritz Hansen** – [www.fritzhansen.com](https://www.fritzhansen.com)
    - Scandinavian design (Series 7, Egg Chair).

---

### **🇺🇸 North America (Mid-Range & Commercial)**
11. **HON** – [www.hon.com](https://www.hon.com)
    - Affordable office furniture (chairs, desks, storage).
12. **Allsteel** – [www.allsteeloffice.com](https://www.allsteeloffice.com)
    - Workplace solutions (part of HNI Corporation).
13. **Global Furniture Group** – [www.globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com)
    - Office seating, tables, and systems.
14. **National Office Furniture** – [www.nationalofficefurniture.com](https://www.nationalofficefurniture.com)
    - Budget-friendly commercial furniture.
15. **La-Z-Boy Office** – [www.la-z-boy.com/office](https://www.la-z-boy.com/office)
    - Ergonomic and executive office chairs.
16. **Sauder** – [www.sauder.com](https://www.sauder.com)
    - Affordable home office furniture (RTA desks, storage).
17. **Bush Furniture** – [www.bushfurniture.com](https://www.bushfurniture.com)
    - Home and small office solutions.
18. **Lorell** – [www.lorell.com](https://www.lorell.com)
    - Budget-friendly office chairs and desks.
19. **Mayline** – [www.mayline.com](https://www.mayline.com)
    - Commercial desks, conference tables.
20. **OFM** – [www.ofm.com](https://www.ofm.com)
    - Affordable office chairs, desks, and accessories.

---

### **🇪🇺 Europe (Design & Ergonomics)**
21. **Sedus** – [www.sedus.com](https://www.sedus.com) (Germany)
    - Ergonomic chairs (se:line, se:fit).
22. **Wilkhahn** – [www.wilkhahn.com](https://www.wilkhahn.com) (Germany)
    - High-end ergonomic seating (ON, Modus).
23. **Flokk** – [www.flokk.com](https://www.flokk.com) (Norway)
    - Brands: **HÅG**, **RH**, **BMA** (ergonomic chairs).
24. **Kinnarps** – [www.kinnarps.com](https://www.kinnarps.com) (Sweden)
    - Sustainable office furniture.
25. **Vitra (Europe)** – [www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com)
    - Same as global, but with EU-specific products.
26. **Actiu** – [www.actiu.com](https://www.actiu.com) (Spain)
    - Modern office and coworking furniture.
27. **Arper** – [www.arper.com](https://www.arper.com) (Italy)
    - Designer chairs (Catifa, Kinesit).
28. **Cassina** – [www.cassina.com](https://www.cassina.com) (Italy)
    - Luxury designer furniture (LC4, LC2 by Le Corbusier).
29. **B&B Italia** – [www.bebitalia.com](https://www.bebitalia.com) (Italy)
    - High-end office seating and sofas.
30. **Hay** – [www.hay.dk](https://www.hay.dk) (Denmark)
    - Modern, affordable office accessories.

---

### **🇨🇳 Asia (Affordable & Mass Market)**
31. **UE Furniture** – [www.uefurniture.com](https://www.uefurniture.com) (China)
    - Office chairs, desks, and commercial furniture.
32. **Sunon** – [www.sunon.com](https://www.sunon.com) (China)
    - Ergonomic chairs and office solutions.
33. **Okamura (Asia)** – [www.okamura.co.jp](https://www.okamura.co.jp) (Japan)
    - Same as global, but with Asia-specific models.
34. **Kokuyo** – [www.kokuyo.co.jp](https://www.kokuyo.co.jp) (Japan)
    - Office supplies and furniture.
35. **HNI Asia** – [www.hni.com](https://www.hni.com) (China/India)
    - Brands: **HON**, **Allsteel** (Asia distribution).
36. **Godrej Interio** – [www.godrejinterio.com](https://www.godrejinterio.com) (India)
    - Office furniture and storage solutions.
37. **Featherlite** – [www.featherlitefurniture.com](https://www.featherlitefurniture.com) (India)
    - Modular office furniture.
38. **KI Asia** – [www.ki.com/asia](https://www.ki.com/asia) (China)
    - Same as global, but with Asia-focused products.

---

### **🛋️ Specialty & Niche Brands**
39. **Uplift Desk** – [www.upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com)
    - Standing desks and ergonomic accessories.
40. **Fully** – [www.fully.com](https://www.fully.com)
    - Standing desks (Jarvis, Jarvis Lite).
41. **Autonomous** – [www.autonomous.ai](https://www.autonomous.ai)
    - Smart office furniture (ErgoChair, SmartDesk).
42. **Branch Furniture** – [www.branchfurniture.com](https://www.branchfurniture.com)
    - Affordable, modern office furniture.
43. **FlexiSpot** – [www.flexispot.com](https://www.flexispot.com)
    - Standing desks and ergonomic chairs.
44. **Secretlab** – [www.secretlab.co](https://www.secretlab.co)
    - Gaming/office chairs (Titan, Omega).
45. **DXRacer** – [www.dxracer.com](https://www.dxracer.com)
    - Gaming chairs (also used in offices).
46. **IKEA** – [www.ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com)
    - Budget-friendly home/office furniture (BEKANT, MARKUS).
47. **Wayfair** – [www.wayfair.com](https://www.wayfair.com)
    - Online marketplace for office furniture.
48. **Amazon Basics** – [www.amazon.com/basics](https://www.amazon.com/basics)
    - Budget office chairs and desks.

---

### **🏢 Commercial & Contract Furniture (B2B)**
49. **Kimball International** – [www.kimballinternational.com](https://www.kimballinternational.com)
    - Brands: **Kimball**, **National**, **Davis**.
50. **MillerKnoll** – [www.millerknoll.com](https://www.millerknoll.com)
    - Parent company of **Herman Miller** and **Knoll**.
51. **HNI Corporation** – [www.hnicorp.com](https://www.hnicorp.com)
    - Owns **HON**, **Allsteel**, **Maxon**, **BPI**.
52. **KI (Krueger International)** – [www.ki.com](https://www.ki.com)
    - Contract furniture for offices, education, healthcare.

---

### **🔍 How to Choose?**
- **Ergonomics?** → Herman Miller, Steelcase, Humanscale, Okamura.
- **Budget-friendly?** → HON, IKEA, Autonomous, Wayfair.
- **Luxury/Design?** → Vitra, Knoll, Fritz Hansen, B&B Italia.
- **Standing desks?** → Uplift, Fully, FlexiSpot.
- **Gaming/Office hybrid?** → Secretlab, DXRacer.

Would you like recommendations for a specific type of furniture (e.g., ergonomic chairs, standing desks, conference tables)?
